name_note: Most genomes GTDB assigns to this species are deposited in NCBI as Ruminococcus bicirculans, and the type strain 80/3 is listed under both names.

sentences.text: Hominimerdicola aceti is the name applied to strain 80/3, which has also been designated 'Ruminococcus bicirculans'.
Members of the genus Hominimerdicola, which includes Hominimerdicola aceti, were reported to exhibit alpha-arabinosidase activity, whereas members of the genus Ruminococcus did not.
An analysis of gut metagenomes reported strain-specific colorectal cancer signatures, with Ruminococcus bicirculans showing subclades associated with late-stage colorectal cancer.
A study of children with Kawasaki disease reported Ruminococcus bicirculans among species that were markedly decreased in that group.
